class.name: StreamReplication
class.brief_description: Server side of streaming-state replication with delta-encoded ready-cell bitsets and anti-cheat validation.
class.description: Each client reports which cells it has fully ready as a compact bitset over a window centred on its cell, XOR-delta-encoded against the last report the server acknowledged (see [StreamReplicationClient]). Reports are always relative to the last acked version, so a lost report or ack only costs a larger delta; when the server no longer has the base version it answers [code]need_full[/code]. The server uses the ready sets for interest management ([method server_relevant]) and rejects claims for cells that are implausibly far from the server-known client cell. Wire format: [code]u32 version, u32 base, s32 cx, s32 cy, u8 radius[/code], then the bitset.

method.name: window_side
method.description: Returns the side length of the report window.

method.name: bit_index
method.description: Returns the bit index of [param cell] in the window, or [code]-1[/code] when outside.

method.name: in_window
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param cell] lies in the window.

method.name: bytes_for
method.description: Returns the bitset size in bytes for a window of [param radius].

method.name: encode_cells
method.description: Encodes a set of cells (a dictionary keyed by [Vector2i]) as a bitset over the window.

method.name: decode_cells
method.description: Decodes a bitset into a dictionary keyed by [Vector2i].

method.name: serialize
method.description: Serializes a report packet ([code]v[/code], [code]base[/code], [code]center[/code], [code]radius[/code], [code]bits[/code]) to the wire format.

method.name: deserialize
method.description: Parses the wire format. Returns an empty dictionary for malformed or truncated data.

method.name: set_client_position
method.description: Sets the server-known cell of [param client].

method.name: apply_report
method.description: Applies a report. Returns [code]{ok, ack, reason, need_full, stripped}[/code], where [code]ack[/code] is the newest applied version to send back to the client.

method.name: ack_version
method.description: Returns the newest applied version of [param client].

method.name: ready_set
method.description: Returns the validated ready cells of [param client] as a dictionary keyed by [Vector2i].

method.name: is_ready
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param client] confirmed [param cell] ready.

method.name: violations
method.description: Returns the violation count of [param client].

method.name: server_relevant
method.description: Returns the subset of [param cells_of_interest] the client has confirmed ready.

method.name: server_missing
method.description: Returns the subset of [param cells_of_interest] the client has not confirmed (hold back state for these).
